race.comment: ESPERANZA (3) is hard to leave off top billing after thrashing them here over 1000m two weeks ago, doing it despite having work to do and some interference early in the straight. She brings the strongest recent figure, has wet-track form and has already won around 1200m, so the step into this looks well within reach. EGMONT (7) is a bit of an unknown but made quite the impression on debut on the Gold Coast Poly. With a bit of Waller polish, he can go on with it. AURORA BLAZE (12) has done little wrong in two starts and she should handle the conditions. UNLOADING (4) might be one to improve on a couple of even runs this time in.
